# Radoslav Radev Says Four Sets Of Planche Lean Presses After The Planche Workout Are An Option

Radoslav Radev says you can do four sets of planche lean presses at the end of the planche workout, like a conditioning exercise. [src: vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 06:37]

## Details

- He says you can do four sets after the planche workout, after your best planche attempts, at the end of the workout like a conditioning exercise. [src: vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 06:37]
- If you train four times per week, he says you can do four sets after each workout. [src: vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 06:53]
- His advice is not to think about a lot of reps, more than 10 reps or 15, and to focus on the quality: the feeling of the muscles, slow and controlled. [src: vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 07:10]

## Evidence

- vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 06:37 (Radoslav Radev): "actually you can just do it four sets after the planche workout after your best attempts of planche of tuck advanced straddle you can do it just in the end of the workout like conditioning exercise"
- vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 06:53 (Radoslav Radev): "so you can do four sets after each workout if you train four times per week you can just do after the workout four sets"
- vid-5zALUKd7h3g @ 07:10 (Radoslav Radev): "my advice for you is to don't think about a lot of reps more than 10 reps 15 like something like this no my advice for you is just to focus on the quality on this exercise the feeling of the muscles slow and controlled"
